title: Inter's Lautaro Martínez finished 22nd in the Ballon d'Or — Kane won it
description:
Inter's captain deserved better than 22nd.
https://www.nerazzurridaily.com/go/yt/?ed=56

Blue means the club said it. Pink means only the papers did.

CONFIRMED · Inter.it · Oct 26 — Lautaro Martínez finished 22nd in the 2026 Ballon d'Or. It was his fifth nomination, the club published no point total, and he was the only Serie A player among the 30 finalists. Harry Kane won the award at the London Palladium.
REPORTED · Sky Sport Italia via FCInterNews · Oct 26 — Sky Sport Italia expects Cristian Chivu to rest Marcus Thuram at Venezia on Wednesday and rotate across the team, with Piotr Zielinski and Petar Sucic in the center.
